subject: CuBERT kickoff - a code encoder for review triage
body:
Hi team,

Kicking off CuBERT. Our open-source release gives us BERT-style models pre-trained on deduplicated Python and Java corpora from public GitHub, plus vocabularies, fine-tuned checkpoints and the run_classifier.py harness for the classification tasks - exception type prediction being the one I keep pointing at in decks.

Product goal: review triage. Given a diff, predict which reviews need a human immediately. Today that's keyword heuristics and it's embarrassing.

Apr 13 - Aug 3:
- May 22: fine-tune the released Python checkpoint on our internal review-outcome labels, get a first accuracy number.
- Jun 26: our own pre-training corpus from the internal monorepo, deduplicated with the released process.
- Jul 24: head-to-head vs the keyword baseline; launch review packet.

Alina will send resourcing this week. Gustavo is tech lead. One thing up front: the deduplication step is not optional - the release is explicit that near-duplicate files inflate results, and I don't want a number we have to retract.

Priya
